### What does this PR do?

as per title.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [ ] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here: ...
- [ ] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI)
  - `{modules}` include `fsdp`, `megatron`, `veomni`, `sglang`, `vllm`, `rollout`, `trainer`, `ci`, `training_utils`, `recipe`, `hardware`, `deployment`, `ray`, `worker`, `single_controller`, `misc`, `perf`, `model`, `algo`, `env`, `tool`, `ckpt`, `doc`, `data`, `cfg`, `reward`, `fully_async`, `one_step_off`
  - If this PR involves multiple modules, separate them with `,` like `[megatron, fsdp, doc]`
  - `{type}` is in `feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `chore`, `test`
  - If this PR breaks any API (CLI arguments, config, function signature, etc.), add `[BREAKING]` to the beginning of the title.
  - Example: `[BREAKING][fsdp, megatron] feat: dynamic batching`

### Test

Validated Qwen3-30B-A3B on 8 GPUs with the following checks:
- Automatic PP inference: Converted HF → MCore with --tp_size 2 --etp_size 2 --ep_size 2, omitting --pp_size. Confirmed TP2/PP2/ETP2/EP2 process groups on all 8 ranks.
- Checkpoint reload: Zeroed all parameters, reloaded the converted checkpoint, and verified exact equality with the HF-loaded parameters on every rank.
- Cross-parallelism loading: Loaded the checkpoint using TP4/PP1/ETP2/EP4, verified every parameter against an independently HF-loaded reference, and saved the checkpoint again.
- Merger comparison: Compared both the original and re-sharded checkpoints against the source HF weights.
- HF round trip: Exported the re-sharded checkpoint to HF. Loading reported no missing, unexpected, or mismatched keys, and all canonical BF16 state tensor hashes matched exactly.
- Forward consistency: Verified identical input IDs and matching last-token logits on one GSM8K sample, using atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5.
All checks passed. VPP remained disabled. These checks cover model-weight conversion and HF forward consistency; they do not cover backward passes, optimizer state, or full training.


 initial conversion is optional. For workflows requiring MCore distributed weights,
